analyticObservation.meaning: Bilinearly sampled contrast-support boundary differs from generator physical endpoint. Six bisections provide numerical interpolation precision, not new image detail or subpixel physical accuracy. Working units must be converted/reported natively posthoc with source footprint.

remainingInterpretationLimits: Root attachment is only observed graph connection to predicted upper arc.
A centerline can switch fibers at unresolved proximal touch/merge without a large rootContactSpan.
Engineering width from one proximal profile is not certified anatomical width.
QualifiedObservation is a hypothesis, never permission for product Length or existing guard bypass.
All prior failed outcomes/tools and fixed exposures must remain available; do not reinterpret V1 abstentions as true-negative accuracy.
